hints.title: Relative Frequency Signatures
hints.text: Notice that equal counts of three characters means the pairwise differences between counts remain invariant.

hints.title: State Key Normalization
hints.text: Store the difference tuple (count_b - count_a, count_c - count_a) in a state mapping.

hints.title: Earliest Index Mapping
hints.text: Record the earliest appearance index of each difference signature to maximize substring span.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map records earliest occurrence of 2D relative difference states.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all substrings naively takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use relative difference tuples as hash map keys for multi-category balance.
